words.en: A sudden, large increase in the size of a population.

words.tr: phrase. 能量和资源的消耗；导致精力与资源枯竭的过程
words.ex: The long work hours cause a drain of energy and resources.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的工作导致精力和资源的耗尽。
words.en: The process of energy and resources being used up or exhausted, often leading to depletion or scarcity.

words.tr: phrase. 生活节奏快；快节奏的生活
words.ex: He lives at a rapid pace of life.
words.ex_cn: 他过着快节奏的生活。
words.en: A fast or quick speed at which life is lived, often implying busyness and little leisure time.

words.tr: phrase. 生活费用高的状况；生活成本高昂
words.ex: The high cost of living makes it hard to save money.
words.ex_cn: 高昂的生活成本让人难以存钱。
words.en: The high cost of living refers to the amount of money needed to sustain a certain standard of living, including basic expenses such as housing, food, taxes, and healthcare.

words.tr: phrase. 田园生活；牧歌式的生活；乡村宁静的生活
words.ex: They live a pastoral life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他们在乡下过着田园生活。
words.en: Relating to the keeping or grazing of sheep or cattle; concerning or appropriate to the giving of spiritual guidance.

words.tr: phrase. 阶级两极分化；社会阶级之间差距扩大，贫富阶级对立加剧的现象
words.ex: The class polarization made it hard for students to work together.
words.ex_cn: 班级的两极分化使学生们难以合作。
words.en: Class polarization refers to the division of society into distinct classes, especially the widening gap between the rich and the poor, leading to increased social and economic disparities.

words.tr: phrase. 城市无规划扩张
words.ex: The city is growing fast because of urban sprawl.
words.ex_cn: 由于城市无序扩张，这个城市正在快速扩张。
words.en: Urban sprawl refers to the expansion of human populations away from central urban areas into low-density, monofunctional and usually car-dependent communities.

words.tr: phrase. 城市更新项目
words.ex: The city started an urban renewal project to fix old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市启动了一项城市更新项目来修复旧建筑。
words.en: A plan to improve and redevelop urban areas.

words.tr: phrase. 方便的交通方式
words.ex: Buses and subways are convenient transportation means in the city.
words.ex_cn: 公交车和地铁是城市里方便的交通方式。
words.en: Convenient transportation means refers to easily accessible and efficient methods of transport that facilitate movement from one place to another with minimal hassle.

words.tr: phrase. 更好的医疗服务
words.ex: The city needs better medical services for its people.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为居民提供更好的医疗服务。
words.en: Higher quality healthcare and treatment options.

words.w: pressure of modern life in city
words.tr: phrase. 现代城市生活的压力
words.uk: ˈpreʃə(r) əv ˈmɒdən laɪf ɪn ˈsɪti
words.us: ˈpreʃər əv ˈmɑːdərn laɪf ɪn ˈsɪti
words.ex: Many people feel the pressure of modern life in city every day.
words.ex_cn: 许多人每天都能感受到城市现代生活的压力。
words.en: The stress and demands experienced by individuals living in urban areas due to the fast-paced and competitive environment.

words.tr: phrase. 熔炉
words.ex: New York is a melting pot of many cultures.
words.ex_cn: 纽约是多种文化的熔炉。
words.en: A place where different peoples, styles, theories, etc., are mixed together.

words.tr: n. 污染物
words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.tr: phrase. 废物处理
words.ex: The city improves waste disposal to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了废物处理以保护环境。
words.en: The process of getting rid of waste materials, especially to prevent harm to the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 消费方式；消费模式
words.ex: People have different ways of consumption in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 大城市里人们有不同的消费方式。
words.en: Methods or patterns by which goods and services are used by individuals or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 城市规划者；负责城市规划的专业人员
words.ex: City planners design roads and parks for better living.
words.ex_cn: 城市规划者设计道路和公园以改善生活。
words.en: City planners are professionals involved in the planning and development of urban areas to ensure sustainable and efficient use of land and resources.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭成员；家属
words.ex: My family members eat dinner together every night.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人每天晚上一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Family members are individuals related by blood, marriage, or adoption, who form a household together.

words.tr: phrase. 家谱
words.ex: He drew a family tree for his school project.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校的作业画了一张家谱。
words.en: A diagram showing the relationships between people in several generations of a family.

words.tr: n.关系
words.ex: He has good relations with his coworkers.
words.ex_cn: 他和同事关系很好。
words.en: Relations refer to the way in which two or more people, groups, countries, etc., talk to, behave toward, and deal with each other.

words.tr: n. 亲属；亲缘植物（或动物）；亲属( relative的名词复数 )；
words.ex: I visited my relatives during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 我在假期探望了我的亲属。
words.en: Your relatives are the members of your family.

words.tr: n. 亲属
words.ex: She invited all her kinfolk to the family reunion.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请了所有的亲属参加家庭团聚。
words.en: Your relatives; your family.

words.tr: n. 亲属；亲戚；
words.ex: She invited all her kin to the family reunion.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请了所有亲属参加家庭聚会。
words.en: Your kin are your relatives.

words.tr: v. 宠坏；搞糟；变质；
words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.tr: n. 社区；团体；群落；
words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr: n. 和谐；协调；
words.ex: The team works in harmony.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队合作得很和谐。
words.en: Harmony is the pleasant combination of different notes of music played at the same time. It can also refer to a situation in which people are peaceful and agree with each other, or when things seem right or suitable together.

words.tr: adj. 过度的；过分的；
words.ex: He ate excessive amounts of candy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了过多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe the amount or level of something as excessive, you disapprove of it because it is more or higher than is necessary or reasonable.

words.tr: phrase. 单亲家庭；由一位父亲或母亲独自抚养子女的家庭
words.ex: Many children in a single-parent family live with their mother.
words.ex_cn: 许多单亲家庭的孩子和他们的母亲一起生活。
words.en: A family consisting of one parent and his or her children.

words.tr: phrase. 破碎的家庭；离异家庭
words.ex: He grew up in a broken family.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个破碎的家庭中长大。
words.en: A family unit that has separated or is no longer intact.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭暴力
words.ex: He called the police because of domestic violence.
words.ex_cn: 他因为家庭暴力报了警。
words.en: Domestic violence refers to violent or aggressive behavior within the home, typically involving the violent abuse of a spouse or partner.

words.tr: phrase. 情感避风港；情绪上的庇护所
words.ex: She found emotional refuge in her journal.
words.ex_cn: 她在日记中找到了情感的避风港。
words.en: A safe place or person that provides emotional comfort and support.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr: n. 社会等级；
words.ex: In some countries, caste determines a person's job and social status.
words.ex_cn: 在一些国家，社会等级决定一个人的职业和社会地位。
words.en: A caste is one of the traditional social classes into which people are divided in a Hindu society.

words.tr:
n. 赛跑；竞争；种族；
v. 比赛；快速移动；
words.ex: He won the race by running fast.
words.ex_cn: 他通过快速奔跑赢得了赛跑。
words.en: A race is a competition to see who is the fastest, for example in running, swimming, or driving.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.tr: n. 家系；世系；血统；
words.ex: He traced his lineage back to ancient kings.
words.ex_cn: 他追溯了自己的家系到古代的国王。
words.en: Your lineage is the series of families from which you are directly descended.

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.tr: phrase. 出身贵族的
words.ex: He was of noble birth and lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 他出身贵族，住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: Having a high social rank or coming from an aristocratic family.

words.tr: phrase. 出身卑微的
words.ex: He was of humble birth but became a great scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他出身卑微，但成为了一名伟大的科学家。
words.en: Born into a family of low social status or modest means.

words.tr: n. 朝代；王朝；
words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.tr: n. 起源；出身；
words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr: n. 开采；提取；
words.ex: The extraction of coal harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 煤炭的开采对环境有害。
words.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from something else.

words.tr: n. 祖先；“ancestor”的复数；
words.ex: My ancestors came from China long ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先很久以前来自中国。
words.en: Your ancestors are the people from whom you are descended.

words.tr: n. 祖先（forebear 的复数）
words.ex: My forebears came from Scotland.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先来自苏格兰。
words.en: Your forebears are the people from whom you are descended.

words.tr: n. 祖先；“forefather”的复数；
words.ex: Our forefathers built this city long ago.
words.ex_cn: 我们的祖先很久以前建造了这座城市。
words.en: Your forefathers are your ancestors, especially your male ancestors.

words.tr: n. 下降；血统；
words.ex: The plane began its descent at 10,000 feet.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在一万英尺高度开始下降。
words.en: The act of moving or falling downward.

words.tr: n. 后代；子女；幼苗；
words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.tr: n. 后代；后裔；“descendant”的复数；
words.ex: His descendants still live in the same village.
words.ex_cn: 他的后代仍然住在同一个村庄里。
words.en: A person's descendants are all the people who are born after them in their family, including their children, grandchildren, and so on.

words.tr: n. 连续；一连串；
words.ex: The succession of rain made the ground wet.
words.ex_cn: 连续的雨水使地面变湿了。
words.en: A succession of things of the same kind is a number of them that exist or happen one after the other.

words.tr: n. 血缘；血亲
words.ex: The two brothers share a strong consanguinity.
words.ex_cn: 这两个兄弟有很强的血缘关系。
words.en: Consanguinity refers to the quality or state of being related to someone by common ancestry or blood relations.

words.tr: phrase. 血缘关系；亲属关系
words.ex: They have a blood relationship because they share the same parents.
words.ex_cn: 他们有血缘关系，因为他们有相同的父母。
words.en: A connection between people based on shared ancestry or biological ties.

words.tr: phrase. 有血缘关系的亲属
words.ex: They are kinsmen by blood and always help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们是血缘亲属，总是互相帮助。
words.en: Relatives connected by direct biological descent, such as parents, children, or siblings.

words.tr: n. 喜爱；类同；密切关系；亲和力
words.ex: She has an affinity for painting.
words.ex_cn: 她喜爱绘画。
words.en: A natural liking for or attraction to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 通过婚姻关系形成的亲属
words.ex: He treats his kinsmen by affinity as family.
words.ex_cn: 他把通过婚姻关系的亲戚当作家人。
words.en: Relatives connected through marriage rather than blood, such as in-laws.

words.tr: phrase. 可归因于；应归于（某种原因或来源）
words.ex_cn: 这个错误归因于粗心。
words.en: If something is attributable to a particular cause, it is likely that it was caused by that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 遭受重大损失；蒙受惨重亏损
words.ex: The army suffered heavy losses in the battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队在战斗中遭受了重大损失。
words.en: To experience or undergo significant damages or defeats.

words.tr: n. 公民；市民；
words.ex: Every citizen must follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都必须遵守法律。
words.en: A citizen is a person who is legally recognized as a member of a country or state, either by birth or by naturalization, and who is entitled to its protection and privileges.

words.tr: phrase. 面临
words.ex: He is confronted with a difficult problem.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困难的问题。
words.en: To be faced with or opposed by something or someone, typically in a challenging or hostile manner.

words.tr: phrase. 可行的措施；指某项计划或方法是切实可行且能够实施的
words.ex: The government proposed a feasible measure to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府提出了一项可行的措施来减少污染。
words.en: A feasible measure refers to a practical and possible action or step that can be taken to achieve a particular goal.

words.tr: phrase. 恶性循环；有害的、自我强化的循环过程
words.ex: Poverty and lack of education form a vicious cycle.
words.ex_cn: 贫困和缺乏教育形成一个恶性循环。
words.en: A situation in which the solution to one problem creates a chain of problems that leads back to the original problem.

words.tr: phrase. 用于实验或测试的动物
words.ex: Scientists use test animals to study new medicines.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用实验动物来研究新药物。
words.en: Animals used in experiments to test the effects of drugs, chemicals, etc., on living organisms.

words.tr: phrase. 动物权利；指动物应享有免受虐待和剥削的基本权利
words.ex: People fight for animal rights to stop cruelty.
words.ex_cn: 人们为动物权利而斗争，以阻止虐待。
words.en: The idea that animals should have moral and legal rights similar to those of humans.

words.tr: phrase. 临床研究；指在人类受试者中进行的科学研究，旨在开发或验证新的医疗、诊断或治疗手段
words.ex: He works in clinical research at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院从事临床研究。
words.en: Clinical research refers to research conducted with human subjects or on material of human origin to understand health and disease better.

words.tr: phrase. 医学研究；医疗科研
words.ex: He does medical research in a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做医学研究。
words.en: Medical research refers to research conducted to aid the body of knowledge in the field of medicine. It can be divided into two general categories: the evaluation of new treatments for both safety and efficacy in what are termed clinical trials, and all other research that contributes to the development of new treatments.

words.tr: phrase. 物种起源
words.ex: Darwin wrote about the origin of species.
words.ex_cn: 达尔文写了关于物种起源的内容。
words.en: A seminal work of scientific literature by Charles Darwin, introducing the scientific theory that populations evolve over generations through a process of natural selection.

words.tr: phrase. 濒危物种
words.ex: Pandas are endangered species.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是濒危物种。
words.en: An endangered species is a type of organism that is at risk of extinction due to a rapid decrease in its population or a loss of its critical habitat.

words.tr: phrase. 濒临灭绝；处于灭绝边缘
words.ex: The panda is on the verge of extinction.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫濒临灭绝。
words.en: At risk of no longer existing; at the point of dying out.

words.tr: phrase. v. 灭绝；消失；不复存在
words.ex: The dinosaur became extinct millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙在数百万年前灭绝了。
words.en: To no longer exist or to die out completely.

words.tr: n. 同伴；伴侣；
words.ex: He walked home with his companion.
words.ex_cn: 他和同伴一起走回家。
words.en: A companion is someone who you spend time with or who you are travelling with.

words.tr: adj. 和谐的；
words.ex: The team worked in a harmonious way.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队以和谐的方式合作。
words.en: A harmonious situation, relationship, or agreement is one in which people are friendly and helpful to one another, and in which there is no serious disagreement or argument.

words.tr: v. 共存；共同存在（指不同事物或群体在同一环境中和平共处）
words.ex: Cats and dogs can co-exist in one house.
words.ex_cn: 猫和狗可以在一个房子里共存。
words.en: To exist or operate simultaneously and peacefully without conflict or interference.

words.tr: n. 共存；共处；
words.ex: Pandas and bamboo coexist in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫和竹子在野外共存。
words.en: The state or fact of existing at the same time or in the same place.

words.tr: phrase. 动物权利活动人士；致力于保护动物权利、反对虐待动物的积极分子
words.ex: Animal rights activists protested outside the laboratory.
words.ex_cn: 动物权利活动家在实验室外抗议。
words.en: People who campaign for the rights of animals to live free from exploitation and abuse by humans.

words.tr: adj. 人造的；人工的；
words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.tr: phrase. 食物链
words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.w: afford their masters consolation and comfort
words.tr: phrase. 向他们的主人提供安慰与慰藉
words.ex: The letter affords their masters consolation and comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这封信给了他们的主人安慰和慰藉。
words.en: Provide solace and emotional support to their superiors or owners.

words.tr: n. 替代品；替换的人[物]；代替( replacement的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The store sold replacements for broken phone screens.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售破损手机屏幕的替代品。
words.en: Items or people that take the place of others, often temporarily or as an alternative.

words.tr: n. 替代物；代替者；替补（运动员）；[语法学]代用词；代替者( substitute的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The recipe uses honey as a substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱用蜂蜜作为糖的替代物。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another. In sports, a substitute is a player who replaces another player during a game.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.tr: n. 实验室
words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.tr: n. 疫苗
words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.tr: phrase. 动物实验；指在科学研究中使用动物进行的实验
words.ex: Scientists do animal experiments to test new medicines.
words.ex_cn: 科学家做动物实验来测试新药物。
words.en: Experiments conducted on animals, especially for scientific research.

words.tr: n. 活体解剖
words.ex: He opposes vivisection because it hurts animals.
words.ex_cn: 他反对活体解剖，因为这会伤害动物。
words.en: The practice of performing operations on live animals for the purpose of experimentation or scientific research (often considered to be cruel).

words.tr:
n. 麻醉剂；麻醉药
adj. 麻醉的
words.ex: The doctor gave him an anesthetic before the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生在手术前给他用了麻醉剂。
words.en: An anesthetic is a substance that causes loss of sensation or consciousness, used especially to prevent pain during medical procedures.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解动物的疼痛
words.ex: The vet gave medicine to alleviate animals' pain.
words.ex_cn: 兽医给了药来缓解动物的疼痛。
words.en: To reduce or lessen the amount of pain or suffering experienced by animals.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解动物的疼痛
words.ex: The vet gave medicine to ease animals' pain.
words.ex_cn: 兽医给了药来减轻动物的疼痛。
words.en: To reduce the suffering of animals.

words.tr:
n. 极端主义者；过激分子
adj. 极端主义的；过激的
words.ex: The extremist refused to listen to others.
words.ex_cn: 这个极端分子拒绝倾听别人的意见。
words.en: An extremist is someone who has extreme political or religious ideas and is willing to do things that are illegal, violent, or not normal in order to achieve their aims.

words.tr: 被绳之以法；受到法律制裁
words.ex: The criminal was finally brought to justice after years of evading the law.
words.ex_cn: v. 这个罪犯在逃避法律多年后终于被绳之以法。
words.en: To be brought to justice means to be arrested, tried, and punished for a crime.

words.tr: adj. 残酷的；
words.ex: The cruel king punished the innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 残酷的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Someone who is cruel deliberately causes pain or distress to others or feels no concern about it.

words.tr: adj. 残忍的；无情的；无慈悲心的；
words.ex: The merciless storm destroyed the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场残忍的风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: If you describe someone as merciless, you mean that they are very cruel or determined and do not show any concern for the effect their actions have on other people.

words.tr: adj. 野蛮的；无人性的；残忍的
words.ex: The prison conditions were inhuman.
words.ex_cn: 监狱的条件十分野蛮。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as inhuman, you mean that they are extremely cruel or unpleasant.

words.tr: adj. 铁石心肠的；无情的；起老茧的
words.ex: He was callous to his friend's pain.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的痛苦无动于衷。
words.en: A callous person or action is very cruel and shows no concern for other people or their feelings.

words.tr: adj. 残酷的；残暴的；
words.ex: The storm caused a brutal flood that destroyed many homes.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了残酷的洪水，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A brutal act or person is cruel and violent.

words.tr: v. 非法猎取；把……踏成泥浆（poach 的现在分词）；
words.ex: He was arrested for poaching elephants in the national park.
words.ex_cn: 他因在国家公园非法猎杀大象而被逮捕。
words.en: Poaching refers to the illegal hunting, killing, or capturing of wild animals, or the act of persuading someone to leave their job and join another company.

words.tr: phrase. 在动物身上进行实验；对动物做实验
words.ex: Scientists perform experiments on animals to test new medicines.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对动物进行实验以测试新药。
words.en: Conduct scientific tests or trials using animals as subjects.

words.tr: phrase. 被用于实验
words.ex: The mice were subjected to experiments to test the new drug.
words.ex_cn: 这些小鼠被用于测试新药的实验。
words.en: To be made to undergo experimental procedures, often in a scientific context.

words.tr: phrase. 物种多样性；指某一地区或生态系统中不同物种的丰富程度和变化性
words.ex: The forest has a diversity of species.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种生物。
words.en: The variety of different species within a particular habitat or ecosystem.

words.tr: phrase. 生物多样性；生物差异
words.ex: The forest has high biological diversity.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林具有很高的生物多样性。
words.en: The variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat or ecosystem.

words.tr: phrase. 生态系统的平衡；指生态系统中各种生物和环境因素之间相互作用达到一种相对稳定的状态
words.ex: The equilibrium of ecosystem keeps animals and plants in balance.
words.ex_cn: 生态系统的平衡使动植物保持平衡。
words.en: The state of balance within an ecosystem where the interactions between organisms and their environment are stable and sustainable.

words.tr: adj. 无耻的；脸皮厚的；不知羞耻的
words.ex: He gave a shameless excuse for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到提供了一个无耻的借口。
words.en: If you describe someone as shameless, you mean that they should be ashamed of their behavior, which is unacceptable to other people.

words.tr: adj. 野蛮的；野蛮人的；
words.ex: The barbaric act shocked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个野蛮的行为震惊了所有人。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as barbaric, you mean that it is extremely cruel or uncivilized.

words.tr: phrase. 自己活也让别人活；宽以待人；互不干涉
words.ex: In a diverse society, it's important to adopt a live and let live attitude.
words.ex_cn: 在一个多元化的社会中，采取一种自己活也让别人活的态度是很重要的。
words.en: A phrase that means to tolerate the opinions and behavior of others so that they will similarly tolerate your own.

words.tr: phrase. 占优势的物种；在特定生态系统中数量多、影响力大的生物种类
words.ex: The lion is a dominant species in the African savanna.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是非洲大草原上的优势物种。
words.en: The most prevalent species in a particular ecological community, which exerts a major controlling influence on the community.

words.tr: n. 违反（法规、规章制度等）；侵犯（合法权益）
words.ex: The company faced a lawsuit for copyright infringement.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司因侵犯版权而面临诉讼。
words.en: An infringement is an action that breaks a rule, law, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 生存权；生命权
words.ex: Every person has the right to live.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有生存的权利。
words.en: The right to live refers to the fundamental human right that every individual has the inherent right to life and should be protected by law.

words.tr:
n. 酷刑；拷打
v. 拷打；折磨
words.ex: The prisoner suffered from torture during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯在战争期间遭受了酷刑。
words.en: Torture is the act of deliberately inflicting severe physical or psychological pain on someone, typically to extract information or a confession, or as a punishment.

words.tr: adj. 反科学的；反对科学的
words.ex: He is anti-science and refuses to believe in vaccines.
words.ex_cn: 他反科学，拒绝相信疫苗。
words.en: Opposed to or rejecting scientific principles, methods, or findings.

words.tr: phrase. 危及生命的疾病
words.ex: He recovered from life-threatening diseases after months of treatment.
words.ex_cn: 经过数月的治疗，他从危及生命的疾病中康复了。
words.en: Diseases that pose a serious risk to a person's life.

words.tr: phrase. 科学的 + n. 收获；成果；收益（指在科学领域取得的进步或成就）
words.ex: The scientific gains from the experiment helped improve medicine.
words.ex_cn: 这项实验的科学收获帮助改进了医学。
words.en: Scientific gains refer to the benefits or advancements achieved through scientific research and study.

words.tr: n. 进化；演变；发展；
words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机模拟；通过计算机模型模仿真实系统或过程的行为
words.ex: The scientist uses computer simulation to predict weather.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用计算机模拟来预测天气。
words.en: A model of a system or process created using computer software.

words.tr: adj. 无根据的；无理由的
words.ex: The accusation was completely groundless.
words.ex_cn: 这个指控完全没有根据。
words.en: If you say that a fear, accusation, or story is groundless, you mean that it is not based on evidence and is unlikely to be true or valid.

words.tr: adj. 人道的；仁慈的；人文的
words.ex: The shelter treats animals in a humane way.
words.ex_cn: 这个收容所以人道的方式对待动物。
words.en: If you describe something as humane, you mean that it is good and kind, especially because it decreases suffering.

words.tr: phrase. 医疗技术；医学技术；用于诊断、治疗和预防疾病的科学技术
words.ex: Medical technology helps doctors treat patients better.
words.ex_cn: 医疗技术帮助医生更好地治疗病人。
words.en: The application of scientific knowledge for medical purposes, including devices and procedures.

words.tr: n. 解剖体组织构造；
words.ex: The students learned the anatomy of the human heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们学习了人类心脏的解剖组织构造。
words.en: Anatomy is the study of the structure of the bodies of people or animals.

words.tr:
adj. 相等的；同等的；
v. 等于；比得上；
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If two things are equal, or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.tr: adj. 不可靠的；不能信赖的；
words.ex: This clock is unreliable; it often stops.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟不可靠；它经常停。
words.en: If you describe a person, machine, or method as unreliable, you mean that you cannot trust them.

words.tr: adj. 有效的；有根据的；
words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.tr: phrase. 被判定犯有（某项罪行）
words.ex: He was convicted of stealing a car.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷车被定罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 替代方法；可选择的方法
words.ex: He tried an alternative method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他尝试了一种替代方法来解决这个问题。
words.en: A different way or technique of doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 自然平衡；生态平衡
words.ex: The forest maintains a natural balance between animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 森林在动物和植物之间维持着自然的平衡。
words.en: The state of equilibrium within an ecosystem, where the interrelationships between organisms and their environment are stable and sustainable.

words.tr: phrase. 一种永恒的主题；持久不变的主题
words.ex: Love is an ever-lasting theme in poetry.
words.ex_cn: 爱是诗歌中永恒的主题。
words.en: A subject or topic that remains relevant or significant over a long period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 先进科学；高级科学
words.ex: He is learning advanced science at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习高级科学。
words.en: A branch of science that deals with the most recent and sophisticated developments in a particular field.

words.tr: phrase. 双刃剑
words.ex: Technology is a double-edged sword: it helps us but can also harm us.
words.ex_cn: 技术是一把双刃剑：它帮助我们，但也可能伤害我们。
words.en: A double-edged sword is something that has or can have both favorable and unfavorable consequences.

words.tr: phrase. 震撼世界的；翻天覆地的（指引起巨大影响或变革的）
words.ex: The new law brought earth-shaking changes to the country.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律给国家带来了翻天覆地的变化。
words.en: Earth-shaking changes refer to very significant or radical changes that have a profound impact.

words.tr: phrase. 能源危机；指由于能源供应不足或价格上涨导致的严重能源短缺情况
words.ex: The country faces an energy crisis because of too little oil.
words.ex_cn: 由于石油太少，这个国家面临能源危机。
words.en: A situation in which the demand for energy resources exceeds the available supply, leading to a shortage and potentially causing economic and social problems.

words.tr: n. 突破；突破性进展；
words.ex: The scientist made a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家在癌症研究中取得了突破。
words.en: A breakthrough is a significant development or achievement that helps to solve a problem or improve a situation.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.tr: phrase. 科学进步；科学进展
words.ex: Scientific advances have greatly improved our quality of life.
words.ex_cn: 科学进步极大地提高了我们的生活质量。
words.en: Scientific advances refer to the significant progress or developments made in the field of science, which often lead to new knowledge, technologies, or improvements in existing methods.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr: v. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.tr: 增强我们对...的意识
words.ex: This program helps enhance our awareness of environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目有助于增强我们对环境问题的意识。

words.tr: n. 生产率；生产力；
words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.tr: adj. 有益的；有用的；
words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: Promoting or enhancing well-being; advantageous.

words.tr: adj. 积极的；正面的；
words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.tr: adj. 耗费劳力的；费力的
words.ex: Hand sewing is labor-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手工缝纫很费力。
words.en: Requiring a lot of work or effort to be done.

words.tr: adj. 耗时的
words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.tr: phrase. 劳动密集型产业；需要大量人力的工业
words.ex: This factory is a labor-intensive industry because it needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂是一个劳动密集型产业，因为它需要很多工人。
words.en: An industry that requires a large amount of labor to produce its goods or services, often characterized by lower levels of technology and capital investment compared to other industries.

words.tr: phrase. 信息爆炸
words.ex: The information explosion makes it hard to find true news.
words.ex_cn: 信息爆炸使找到真实新闻变得困难。
words.en: The rapid increase in the amount of information available, especially due to the advent of the internet and digital technologies.

words.tr: phrase. 虚拟教室；指通过互联网技术实现的在线教学环境，用于远程教育和互动学习
words.ex: The virtual classroom allows students to attend lectures from anywhere in the world.
words.ex_cn: 虚拟教室使学生能够从世界任何地方参加讲座。
words.en: A virtual classroom is an online learning environment that allows teachers and students to communicate, interact, collaborate, and explain ideas. It simulates the experience of a physical classroom through internet technologies.

words.tr: phrase. 网络诈骗；线上欺诈
words.ex: He lost money to online fraud last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月在网上诈骗中损失了钱。
words.en: Deception or cheating that is carried out via the internet.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.tr: phrase. 工业革命
words.ex: The industrial revolution changed how people made things.
words.ex_cn: 工业革命改变了人们制造东西的方式。
words.en: The Industrial Revolution was the transition to new manufacturing processes in the period from about 1760 to sometime between 1820 and 1840.

words.tr: n. 自动化
words.ex: The factory uses automation to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用自动化来制造汽车。
words.en: The use of largely automatic equipment in a system of manufacturing or other production process.

words.tr: phrase. 显著提高工业效率
words.ex: The new machine considerably boosts industrial efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器显著提高了工业效率。
words.en: To significantly increase the productivity and effectiveness of manufacturing processes.

words.tr: phrase. 普遍的应用；无处不在的应用
words.ex: The pervasive application of smartphones changes daily life.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机的广泛应用改变了日常生活。
words.en: The widespread and extensive use of something across many areas or sectors.

words.tr: phrase. 不合理的高失业率
words.ex: The country has an unreasonably high unemployment rate.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的失业率高得不合理。
words.en: An excessively high rate of joblessness that is not justified by economic conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 社会不满
words.ex: People show social dissatisfaction when prices rise too fast.
words.ex_cn: 当物价上涨太快时，人们表现出社会不满。
words.en: A feeling of discontent or frustration among members of a society.

words.tr: phrase. 增加政府的负担
words.ex: More poor people increase burden on the government.
words.ex_cn: 更多穷人增加了政府的负担。
words.en: To add a greater financial or operational strain to the state's resources and responsibilities.

words.tr: phrase. 不可再生的化石燃料
words.ex: Cars use non-renewable fossil fuels like coal and oil.
words.ex_cn: 汽车使用煤炭和石油等不可再生的化石燃料。
words.en: Energy sources like coal, oil, and natural gas that cannot be replenished in a human timescale.

words.tr: phrase. 高科技图书馆；配备先进数字设备和技术服务的图书馆
words.ex: The hi-tech library has robots that help students find books.
words.ex_cn: 高科技图书馆有机器人帮助学生找书。
words.en: A library equipped with advanced technology for digital resources and services.

words.tr: phrase. 多媒体设施
words.ex: The school has a new multimedia facility for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生配备了一个新的多媒体设施。
words.en: A space offering various media formats like audio, video, and digital content.

words.tr: phrase. 存储容量；储存能力
words.ex: The phone has a large storage capacity.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的存储容量很大。
words.en: The maximum amount of data that can be stored in a storage device or system.

words.tr: phrase. 提高工作效率
words.ex: He uses a new tool to improve working efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一个新工具来提高工作效率。
words.en: To enhance productivity and effectiveness in work processes.

words.tr: adj. 节省时间的
words.ex: This app is time-conserving because it does tasks quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序是节省时间的，因为它能快速完成任务。

words.tr: 给人们的日常生活带来便利
words.ex: Smartphones bring convenience to people's life.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机为人们的生活带来便利。
words.en: To make daily life easier and more convenient for individuals.

words.tr: phrase. 促进沟通；使交流更顺畅
words.ex: A good teacher can facilitate communication in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 一位好老师可以在课堂上促进交流。
words.en: To make it easier for people to exchange information or ideas.

words.tr: n. 休闲娱乐；
words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.tr: phrase. 丰富人们的生活
words.ex: Reading books can enrich people's life.
words.ex_cn: 读书可以丰富人们的生活。

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏面对面的交流
words.ex: They lack face-to-face communication because they work remotely.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为远程工作而缺乏面对面的交流。
words.en: The absence of direct, in-person interaction between people.

words.tr: phrase. 侵犯人们的隐私
words.ex: The app infringes people's privacy by collecting their data without permission.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序在未经许可的情况下收集用户数据，侵犯了人们的隐私。
words.en: To violate or encroach upon an individual's personal privacy.

words.tr: phrase. 强烈辐射；高强度辐射
words.ex: The astronauts were exposed to intense radiation during the solar flare.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员在太阳耀斑期间暴露于强辐射中。
words.en: Intense radiation refers to high levels of radiation, which can be harmful to living organisms and materials.

words.tr: phrase. 视力衰退；视力下降
words.ex: His failing eyesight makes it hard to read small print.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力衰退让他很难阅读小字。

words.tr: 健康危害
words.ex: Smoking is a health hazard.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟是一种健康危害。
words.en: A condition or activity that poses a risk to physical or mental well-being, potentially causing illness or injury.

words.tr: phrase. 促进经济发展；推动经济增长
words.ex: The government wants to promote economic development in rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望促进农村地区的经济发展。
words.en: To encourage or support the growth or improvement of economic activities and conditions in a region or country.

words.tr: phrase. 促进经济发展；推动经济成长
words.ex: The new factory will boost economic development in the region.
words.ex_cn: 这家新工厂将促进该地区的经济发展。
words.en: To boost economic development means to promote or accelerate the growth of a country's economy through various measures such as investment, innovation, and policy reforms.

words.tr: phrase. 提高人民的生活水平；改善人们的生活标准
words.ex: The new policy helps improve people's living standard.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策有助于提高人民的生活水平。
words.en: To make better or raise the quality of life for individuals or communities.

words.tr: phrase. 提供就业机会
words.ex: The new factory will provide opportunities of employment for local people.
words.ex_cn: 这家新工厂将为当地人提供就业机会。
words.en: To offer jobs or work positions to people.

words.w: have access to all kinds of information
words.tr: phrase. 能够获取各种信息
words.uk: hæv ˈækses tu ɔːl kaɪndz əv ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃən
words.us: hæv ˈækses tu ɔːl kaɪndz əv ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən
words.ex: He can have access to all kinds of information on the internet.
words.ex_cn: 他可以通过互联网获取各种信息。
words.en: To be able to use or obtain a wide range of data and knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 被负面信息淹没
words.en: To be overwhelmed by a large amount of negative data or news.

words.tr: n. （总称）色情（或淫秽）作品
words.ex: He found pornography on the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上发现了色情内容。
words.en: Pornography refers to books, magazines, films, or other materials that are intended to cause sexual excitement by showing naked people or describing sexual acts.

words.tr: n. 暴力；
words.ex: The movie shows too much violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了太多的暴力。
words.en: Violence is behavior which is intended to hurt, injure, or kill people.

words.tr: n. 安全；保障；防护措施；
words.ex: The school improved security to protect students.
words.ex_cn: 学校加强了安全措施以保护学生。
words.en: Security refers to the state of being free from danger or threat, or measures taken to ensure safety.

words.tr: n. 网络犯罪
words.ex: He was arrested for cybercrime last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月因网络犯罪被逮捕。
words.en: Cybercrime refers to criminal activities carried out by means of computers or the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 资源的枯竭；资源的耗尽
words.ex: The depletion of resources hurts the environment.
words.ex_cn: 资源的枯竭损害了环境。
words.en: The reduction in the quantity or number of something, especially natural resources, due to consumption, decay, or waste.

words.tr: n. 重要事件；
words.ex: Graduating from high school was a big milestone for him.
words.ex_cn: 从高中毕业对他来说是一个重要的事件。
words.en: A milestone is a significant event or stage in the development of something.

words.tr: phrase. 精密的；复杂的；尖端的设备
words.ex: The lab uses sophisticated equipment to measure tiny changes.
words.ex_cn: 实验室使用精密的设备来测量微小的变化。
words.en: Sophisticated equipment refers to advanced and complex devices or machinery that are designed for specific purposes, often requiring specialized knowledge to operate.

words.tr: phrase. 技术革新
words.ex: The company made a technical innovation last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年做了一项技术创新。
words.en: Technical innovation refers to the process of improving products, processes, or services through the application of new technologies or methods. It is a key driver of economic growth and competitiveness.

words.tr: n. 权宜；与目的相称；私利
words.ex: He ignored the rules for expediency.
words.ex_cn: 他为了方便而忽略了规则。
words.en: Expediency is the quality of being convenient and practical despite possibly being improper or immoral.

words.tr: phrase. 科学发明
words.ex: The scientist made a scientific invention last year.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家去年做出了一项科学发明。
words.en: A scientific invention refers to a new device, method, or process developed from scientific knowledge and research.

words.tr: 名词短语. 一场激烈的讨论
words.ex: They had a heated discussion about the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他们就新规定进行了一场激烈的讨论。
words.en: A heated discussion is a conversation or debate that is very intense and often involves strong emotions or disagreements.

words.tr: phrase. 尾气；废气
words.ex: The car releases exhaust gas from its tailpipe.
words.ex_cn: 汽车从尾管排放废气。
words.en: Exhaust gas refers to the gases expelled from an engine as waste products of combustion.

words.tr: phrase. 相反的力量；对立力；对抗力
words.ex: The two opposite forces cancel each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两个相反的力相互抵消。
words.en: Forces that are in direct contrast or conflict with each other.

words.tr: phrase. 一次致命的故障；致命的崩溃
words.ex: The old machine had a fatal breakdown last night.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧机器昨晚发生了致命故障。
words.en: A fatal breakdown refers to a catastrophic failure or collapse that leads to severe consequences, often irreversible.

words.tr: phrase. 潜在危险；潜在危害因素
words.ex: The signs warn of potential hazards near the construction site.
words.ex_cn: 标志警告施工区域附近有潜在危险。
words.en: Potential hazards refer to possible sources of harm or adverse health effects on people, or combinations of these in the workplace.

words.tr: phrase. 交通工具；运输方式；交通手段
words.ex: Buses and bikes are common means of transportation in the city.
words.ex_cn: 公交车和自行车是城市中常见的交通工具。
words.en: Means of transportation refers to the various methods and systems used to move people and goods from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 运输工具；用于运送人或货物的设备或装置，如汽车、火车、飞机等
words.ex: Bicycles are simple transportation tools.
words.ex_cn: 自行车是简单的交通工具。
words.en: Tools or devices used for the movement of people or goods from one place to another.

words.tr: 社会地位
words.ex: He cares about his social status.
words.ex_cn: 他在乎自己的社会地位。
words.en: Social status refers to the position or rank of a person or group within the society, often determined by factors such as wealth, education, and occupation.

words.tr: phrase. 环保的资源；对环境友好的资源；可持续利用的自然资源
words.ex: We use environmentally-friendly resources like bamboo and recycled paper.
words.ex_cn: 我们使用竹子和再生纸等环保资源。
words.en: Resources that are not harmful to the environment, often used in the context of sustainable development and conservation efforts.

words.tr: phrase. 代用燃料
words.ex: The car uses alternative fuel to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车使用替代燃料以减少污染。
words.en: A fuel that is not derived from petroleum and is considered to be less harmful to the environment than traditional fuels.

words.tr: phrase. 可持续发展
words.ex: The town uses solar power for sustainable development.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇使用太阳能来实现可持续发展。
words.en: Sustainable development refers to development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

words.tr: phrase. 科学探索；科学考察
words.ex: Scientists are doing scientific exploration in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们正在沙漠中进行科学探索。
words.en: The systematic investigation and study of materials and sources in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions, often in a scientific context.

words.tr: phrase. 航空旅行；乘飞机旅行
words.ex: He likes air travel because it is fast.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢航空旅行，因为它很快。
words.en: The action or activity of traveling by aircraft.

words.tr: phrase. 能解决所有问题的万能方案；灵丹妙药
words.ex: There is no cure-all solution for every problem.
words.ex_cn: 没有一种万能的解决方案能解决所有问题。
words.en: A cure-all solution is something that is believed to solve all problems or cure all diseases, often regarded as overly simplistic or unrealistic.

words.tr: phrase. 一种民族自豪感
words.ex: He felt a sense of national pride when his country won the gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 当他国家赢得金牌时，他感到一种民族自豪感。
words.en: A sense of national pride: A feeling of satisfaction and self-respect derived from one's national identity.
